description:
The PostJoy GT30 is built for riders who want power, range, portability, and all-terrain confidence in one electric bike. With a 1500W motor, 48V 20Ah battery, up to 30MPH top speed, and up to 65 miles of range, the GT30 is ready for daily commuting, weekend cruising, and outdoor adventures.

Key Features

1500W Motor: Delivers strong power for daily rides, hills, and mixed terrain.

48V 20Ah Battery: Long-lasting battery supports up to 65 miles of riding range.

30MPH Top Speed: Enjoy faster commuting and more exciting riding performance.

20" x 4.0" Fat Tires: Provides stable traction on pavement, gravel, sand, snow, and rough roads.

Folding Design: Easy to fold, store, and transport for riders with limited space.

NFC Smart Unlock: Unlock your ride with a smarter and more convenient access system.

Disc Brakes: Reliable braking performance for safer control on different road conditions.

365 lbs Max Load: Strong frame support for a wide range of adult riders.

7-Speed System: Flexible gear shifting for different riding needs.

IP6 Rated: Designed with water-resistant protection for daily outdoor use.

Powerful 1500W Performance
The GT30 is equipped with a 1500W motor designed to deliver smooth acceleration and dependable riding power. Whether you are commuting through the city, climbing moderate hills, or exploring outdoor paths, the GT30 gives you the performance you need.

48V 20Ah Long-Range Battery
Ride farther with the high-capacity 48V 20Ah battery. With up to 65 miles of range, the GT30 helps reduce charging frequency and gives you more freedom for everyday transportation and weekend rides.

Foldable Frame for Easy Storage
The folding design makes the GT30 easier to store at home, place in a garage, or transport in a vehicle. It is a practical choice for riders who want the power of a fat tire electric bike with added portability.

20" x 4.0" Fat Tires for All-Terrain Confidence
Wide 20" x 4.0" fat tires provide better grip, balance, and stability across different surfaces. From city streets and bike paths to gravel roads, sand, snow, and uneven terrain, the GT30 is built to handle more.

NFC Smart Unlock
The NFC smart unlock system adds convenience and a modern riding experience. Unlock your e-bike quickly and enjoy smarter access before every ride.

Reliable Disc Brakes
The GT30 uses disc brakes to provide stable and responsive stopping power. Whether riding at higher speeds or navigating busy roads, reliable braking helps improve control and safety.

Built for Everyday Riders
With a 365 lbs max load capacity, 7-speed shifting, IP6 water-resistant design, and durable fat tire construction, the GT30 is made for adult riders who want a practical and powerful electric bike for commuting, cruising, and exploring.

Important Notes
Actual speed and range may vary depending on rider weight, terrain, temperature, battery level, riding mode, tire pressure, wind conditions, and local regulations. Please follow all local e-bike laws and ride safely.
